name: Wild Trout Rivers (Rhodes, Wartrail & New England)
permit_info: Over 200 km of running water — wild trout rivers around Rhodes, Wartrail & New England. Fly-fishing only, subject to compliance with Foot & Mouth Disease protocols. Target species: Trout and Smallmouth Yellowfish. No closed season. Day permits arranged with the Rhodes Information Centre (045 971 9003, info@rhodesinfo.co.za). More info: www.wildtrout.co.za
